title: Loop terminates immediately
statement: Let a program, depth bound, condition $c$, body statement $s$, initial state $\sigma$, time bound $T\in\mathbb N$, and postcondition $Q$ be given. If $c$ is safe and false at $\sigma$, $Q$ holds at $\sigma$, and $\operatorname{cost}(c)+1\le T$, then the loop with condition $c$ and body $s$ ends in a state satisfying $Q$ within time $T$.
hypotheses_covered: The condition is safe at the initial state
The condition is false at the initial state
The postcondition holds at the initial state
The condition-check cost is at most $T$
